profile.headline: Software Engineer | Lead Developer of Pioneer
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who's spent the last 4+ years shipping and owning production features on a single industrial IoT platform, currently as Software Engineer / Pioneer Project Lead at DSQ Technology, promoted up from Junior Software Engineer in 2023. I build full-stack (Laravel + Vue 3/Inertia) product UI, backend jobs, and schema for a waste-compactor monitoring system used by real hauling clients, and I own the pipeline that gets hardware sensor data into that product, from webhook ingestion through work-order automation.
 
Over the past year I've moved deep into applied AI: wiring the Gemini API into a production Python service (retries, model fallback, cost tracking, and a DeepEval evaluation harness), and piloting agentic AI workflows (Claude Code multi-agent orchestration) to automate parts of our own engineering process.
 
Outside of work, I built and maintain Second Brain, a self-hosted AI-powered personal knowledge base (FastAPI + React + ChromaDB RAG pipeline, multi-provider LLM support, 300+ commits), my most extensive personal project.
 
What I'm good at:
 
Laravel + Vue full-stack delivery inside existing multi-tenant applications
IoT/webhook ingestion architecture, sensor data to business logic to automated action
Production LLM ops. Not model training, but making frontier APIs reliable in real pipelines
AI agent tooling and automation (Claude Code, MCP)
Growing practice in Django + Django-Ninja + Pydantic typed APIs
 
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM I). Currently pursuing a combined BS/MS in Computer Science (AI/ML Specialization) at WGU.

projects.title: Second Brain
projects.description: Self-hosted, AI-powered personal knowledge base with an infinite spatial canvas. FastAPI + React/React Flow + ChromaDB RAG pipeline; multi-provider LLM support (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, MiniMax) swappable without restart; ingests 10+ content types (YouTube, TikTok, podcasts via local Whisper, PDFs, GitHub repos, Google Docs); automatic semantic + typed knowledge-graph edges between items, a 3D force-directed mind map, and a background ingest queue. Ships as a one-click Windows installer and a Docker self-hosting path. github.com/triss-smith/secondbrain
